facts.fact: Brooks 走进屋子把她堵在冰箱前，一只手撑在头顶柜门。
facts.anchor: Brooks stalks through the house, finding me at the fridge and caging me in, one hand on the door above my head.

facts.fact: 他道歉：不是想吵架，只是无法原谅本可阻止她受伤的自己。
facts.anchor: I just don’t want to see you get hurt, you know? I couldn’t forgive myself if you got hurt and I could’ve stopped it.

facts.fact: 临走前他绕屋道晚安、向她敬礼眨眼才开车离去。
facts.anchor: Before he leaves, he circles the house, saying goodnight to everyone, then offers me a salute and one final wink before he climbs into his truck and roars away.

facts.fact: 爸爸催她回家睡觉：明天 Mick 借她驯马，自己要进城。
facts.anchor: Go on, kiddo. Go home. Get some sleep. Mick says he’s borrowin’ you for some horse trainin’ tomorrow.

facts.fact: 回到小屋发现门口台阶上有个无地址标签的棕色小盒。
facts.anchor: When I reach my cabin, there’s a small box on my doorstep. Brown and unassuming.

facts.fact: 手写便条说她唇膏快用完，署名 B x。
facts.anchor: Looked like you were getting low on that goopy cupcake stuff. B x

facts.fact: 回忆：Ms. Josie 派四人去 Heath 郊外 Aunt Roberta 自摘农场采草莓。
facts.anchor: Teenage and wild, Ms. Josie entrusted the four of us—me, Brooks, Ev, and Jody—to fill a couple buckets with berries at Aunt Roberta’s U-Pick farm right outside of Heath.

facts.fact: 次日晨跑的 Brooks 要她用新模具给他烤点东西。
facts.anchor: No problem. Bake me somethin’ with those cutters, okay?” He jogs backward as he speaks, before saluting and turning to face his direction of travel.

relations: Brooks 是她一辈子的挚友而她正生出不该有的感觉
爸爸的「爱你到月亮」是从小听到大的对白
他连唇膏牌子口味库存都注意到
Aunt Roberta 终身未婚却是大家的姑姑
numbers: 九点后厨房只剩她和爸爸
盒里有五支纸杯蛋糕味唇膏
爸爸胡茬一两天没刮、灰发变多
